description: For the signed-in vendor: prepares a proposal package on one of your accepted leads, written by code against the market's published proposal model: scope lines included or excluded, phases with duration and dependency, price lines (component, unit, quantity, unit price, currency), assumptions and exclusions, a short note per section, and the currency, term in months and annual escalator. Nothing is sent by this tool: it checks the package, names any field that needs a change, saves it as a draft only your company can read, and returns a link to PreShiftIQ's confirm page, where you confirm as your company's owner or as a member the owner has allowed to prepare and send documents. A client sees the package only after that confirm, and only after asking you for proposals.
name: submit_proposal_package
title: Submit a proposal package
